modelspec.observatory.Histogram.title: Histogram
modelspec.observatory.Histogram.description: The distribution of one tensor's elements in bins, the edges taken anew from that tensor each time statistics are taken (approval-record:parameter-statistics-settlements, question 1). With min and max the tensor's smallest and largest finite element widened to Binary64, a tensor with min < max has 32 bins and the 33 edges min + (max − min) · i / 32 for i from 0 through 32, the last edge max itself; bin i counts the finite elements x with bin_edges[i] <= x < bin_edges[i+1], and the last bin also counts x = max. A tensor with min = max has one bin, edges [min, max], counting every finite element. A tensor with no finite element has no min or max, so no edge and no bin. NaN, +inf and −inf are in no bin; nan_count, positive_infinity_count and negative_infinity_count count them, so the counts and those three sum to the tensor's element count, which ESS does not state here.

bin_edges.description: The bin edges in ascending order. Edges taken between finite min and max are finite; the type keeps null for an edge that is NaN or ±inf, which Binary64 does not hold (wave observatory-1 coordinator, 2026-10-21).

counts.description: The finite elements in each bin, in edge order.

nan_count.description: The tensor's NaN elements, counted in no bin (approval-record:parameter-statistics-settlements, question 1).

positive_infinity_count.description: The tensor's +inf elements, counted in no bin (approval-record:parameter-statistics-settlements, question 1).

negative_infinity_count.description: The tensor's −inf elements, counted in no bin (approval-record:parameter-statistics-settlements, question 1).

x-ess-invariants: ((counts.count == 0 and bin_edges.count == 0) or (counts.count == 1 and bin_edges.count == 2) or (counts.count == 32 and bin_edges.count == 33))
